name: reason-grill
description: Deep argument interrogation — map a claim, attack it from five adversarial angles, and return a calibrated verdict, with a gate that refuses to manufacture objections

interface.shortDescription: Multi-angle argument interrogation with a calibrated verdict
interface.longDescription: Use Reason Grill to interrogate an argument the way a code reviewer interrogates code — map the claim, then attack it from five adversarial angles (logic, evidence, counter, assumptions, integrity). A six-check calibration gate refuses to manufacture objections, so a sound argument mostly returns [SOUND]. Produces a calibrated verdict: HOLDS, HOLDS-IF-NARROWED, WOUNDED, or DEFEATED.
defaultPrompt: Use $reason-grill-roast to interrogate this argument from every angle.
Grill this argument and tell me whether it holds.
